images.caption:
Right time, right place as we strolled over to a restaurant for dinner on our first night in Amsterdam we were treated to a spectacular sunset.
Taken from Java-eiland (Java Island) in Amsterdam with Jan Schaeferburg in the background on the evening of 14 October 2011. The island is now mainly residential with modern apartment blocks seen on the right. As with the rest of the city it is well served by public transport complete with tram route no. 10 terminating there.

images.filename: 1988 - charcoal-drawing of former Eastern harbor area in Amsterdam, artist Fons Heijnsbroek.tif
images.caption: a charcoal-drawing on paper of the former Eastern harbor area in Amsterdam, seen from a pedestrian-bridge over the traintracks full of old trasin-wagons, made in open air by Dutch artist Fons Heijnsbroek. The harbor area was not active any longer as harbor when this sketch was made in 1988. Later Heijnsbroek donated this sketch with others to the Municipal Archive of Amsterdam city. Free download art image CC0 in high resolution TIFF.
